whatsapp.step1_4: Fill in app details and create

templates.title: Message templates
templates.description: Create templates and submit them to Meta for approval. Use "Sync from Meta" to pull templates approved elsewhere.
templates.noTemplatesDescription: Create your first message template to get started.
templates.createDescription: Build a template and submit it to Meta for approval. Once approved, you can use it in broadcasts and the inbox.
templates.editDescription: Save your changes to re-submit to Meta. Status will flip back to PENDING during review.
templates.authWarning: AUTHENTICATION templates have a fixed body + OTP button shape that needs a different builder. Create them in Meta WhatsApp Manager for now and use Sync from Meta to bring them in.
templates.templateNameCreateHelper: Lowercase letters, digits, and underscores only.
templates.templateNameEditHelper: Name is fixed once a template exists on Meta — create a new template to change it.
templates.languageEditHelper: Language is fixed once a template exists on Meta.
templates.languageCreateHelper: Must match the exact code on Meta — en_US and en are distinct.
templates.samplePlaceholder: Sample value for {{1}} (required for Meta review)
templates.imageDetailHint: Upload a JPEG/PNG (≤5 MB, ≥800×418 px recommended) or paste a public HTTPS link.
templates.videoHint: Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS link. Recommended: MP4 / 3GPP, ≤16 MB, ≤60 seconds.
templates.documentHint: Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS link. Recommended: PDF, ≤100 MB.
templates.bodyTextHelper: Use {{1}}, {{2}} for variables (must be contiguous starting at {{1}}).
templates.sampleValues: Sample values (Meta uses these to review your template)
templates.buttonsHelper: Up to {n} buttons. QUICK_REPLY buttons must come before URL / phone / copy-code buttons.
templates.urlExamplePlaceholder: Example value for {{1}} (required when URL has a variable)
templates.deleteMetaBody: "{name}" will be deleted from Meta and from wacrm. Active broadcasts using this template will start failing on their next send. This can't be undone.
templates.deleteLocalBody: "{name}" will be deleted from wacrm. It was never submitted to Meta, so no remote cleanup is needed.
templates.submittedForReview: Edit submitted — Meta typically reviews within 24 hours.
templates.submittedToMeta: Submitted to Meta — typical review time is 24 hours. Status updates automatically.
templates.synced: Synced {n} template(s) from Meta ({inserted} new, {updated} updated)
templates.syncLimitReached: Synced the first 2000 templates only — your account has more. Sync again to continue.
templates.headerImageFormat: Header image must be a JPEG or PNG.
templates.headerImageSize: Image is {size} MB — Meta's limit is 5 MB.
